judgments.reason: The specification claims bids can exceed available coins because a 3-coin commission is applied before payment. The rules explicitly state a bid cannot exceed your coins and that the winner pays the bid then receives a three-coin commission, so the claimed precedence is false.

The specification asserts waiting reveals sealed rival bids before you commit. The rules state sealed rival bids should remain private and only resolved bids are normally public, so waiting does not reveal others' committed sealed bids.

The specification says close settles the game even with unauctioned lots. The rules describe [close: 1] as settling after all three lots are sold; evidence shows close accepted only after all lots resolved, so the claimed terminal condition is incorrect.

The specification claims catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission. The rules specify the three-coin commission is given to the auction winner; catalog items are not auction wins, so they do not receive that commission.
